arithmetic_replay.method: stdlib math.fsum; neuron mean within source sample UUID, followed by equal mean across all22 animals. Saved scorer used numpy.mean; floating summation differences reported exactly.

after_this_run.future_tuning_reuse: Any future use for model selection is development; this cohort must not be described as a fresh independent test again.

before_this_run.image_exposure_disclosure: PVH source-only raw image patch from2017-04-19 was inspected/acquired after the E4/E6 recipes were frozen. Those recipes ignore image pixels and have not been refitted. This brain is development data for any future image-conditioned model.
before_this_run.interpretation: The 18 names in the Jiao supplement ZIP listing are not evidence of model exposure or shared experimental mice. The files were explicitly excluded by the acquisition code; no automatic exclusions follow from names alone.
before_this_run.limits: Independent source-study animals and actual consumed IDs/provenance support this external transfer admission. This audit does not establish that public traces were never visible to any researcher or that every historical file was never renamed; it checks recorded pipeline inputs and current geometry filenames. No fresh gene-model validation is claimed.

limitations_and_interpretation: Descriptive prospective external transfer on97 neurons from22 MouseLight brains; no population-significance or validated-winner claim.
E4 and E6 were fixed candidates after failed prior gates; molecular labels were absent and marginalized. This was soma-only pathway prediction, not a gene-conditioned or image-conditioned test.
E4 beats nearest and global-medoid plain copying on both means, but loses to E1 and E2 local aggregation. E6 does not beat every fixed control on both means. No model promotion follows.

Source calibration establishes separately identified axon-domain conversion, shared physical atlas coordinate basis and units. It does not independently validate nonlinear biological registration accuracy or establish that the CCFV30 request parameter selects a coordinate warp.

Hash replay establishes integrity relative to sealed records; it does not prove all historical aliases, renames or undocumented exposure absent. The prospectively pinned exposure audit states its recorded-input and filename scope.

mechanical_source_replay.method: Independent stdlib raw JSON domain/root/parent/finite/role/connectivity checks; deterministic role-preserving SWC byte reconstruction; raw cable and transformed soma recomputation. No model/geometry metric code imported.

public_prediction_lock.limitation: Post-run remote reachability and GitHub commit metadata do not independently attest first-push wall time. ROOT recorded public verification before acquisition; local sealed acquisition records follow the displayed commit time.

scope: Independent verification of saved seals, hashes, source conversion/QC and arithmetic reaggregation. No fit, predict or score command called; no geometry accuracy recomputation or new inferential threshold.
